settings.description: Register entry D2 (spec/V0.8-DECISIONS.md, #133): embedded tiers. Native codes 0-4 on the shipped channel-sequential order ('tK native'); the same codes in the interleaved order (Tunables::interleave, alpha's AC codes merged as a fourth channel) at full length, each identicalTo its native arm, so the run fails if any image decodes to other pixels (part 1); the interleaved cuts 'tJ interleaved cut k', a code-J hash decoded from only the first L(k) bytes of its alpha mode (Tunables::cut_tier, rendered at code k's natural size) for k = 1, 2, 3 and J = k + 1; and the same cuts of a channel-sequential hash ('tJ seq cut k') as the control that prices the interleaving, which judge nothing. Cut k is read against 'tk native', and its margin is the paired gap from 't(k-1) native' to 'tk native' in the same run (D2's 'How the primary metric is read'). Bytes are the encoded hash's, not the cut's. Corpus all with realOnly: the photographic, alpha and graphics tune images, so the holdout3 read covers every stratum. Rows against the code-0 incumbent, which the printed tables show by default, are at other byte counts and are not judged.
